domain: Classical molecular dynamics of a water/octane configuration
scientific_question: Advance a molecular configuration under Lennard–Jones and periodic Ewald forces with the source NVT Nose–Hoover thermostat and rigid-body rotations.
mathematical_operation: Eleven all-pairs LJ + real/reciprocal Ewald force evaluations (kmax3), complete original CPU integration, rotation, thermostat, potential, observables and file-I/O pipeline.
classification_rationale: Particle/molecular simulation with pair potentials and reciprocal periodic charge interactions; the selected input uses MD, not Monte Carlo.
community_use_case: Molecular simulation developers comparing force accuracy and a complete CPU/GPU integration path. No equilibrium chemical accuracy or infinite-Ewald convergence claim.
support_boundary: Original input: 3,379 ATOM records minus eight BOX markers = 3,371 physical atoms, 955 molecules, 10 fs with dt1 fs, pform1 LJES, kmax3, orthogonal 50 Å cell. Other potential modes/MC/SP/optimization are not certified. Original CPU integrator is shared, not independently rewritten.
accuracy_requirements: All returned GPU atom buffers and actual device inputs for every force call; initial47,220-value raw Float64 prefix is bit-exact. All2,517,798 artifact fields per trial compare at absolute2e-6 + relative2e-10. Independent long-double force checks cover every coordinate at all11 steps; additional finite/rigid-distance/total-force checks. Listed host vectors and four statistics are captured; not all CLI bytes or unlisted host statistics.
scientific_task: Full original 10 fs molecular-dynamics trajectory for 3,371 physical atoms and 955 movable molecules.
